source:
The milf of the neighborhood, Keita's mom roils... in her own eros of moral decline! She forgot what it's like to be a woman until a bratty boy broke her down with sex training. If she was everyone's mom in spirit, I was like a second son. I had deep feelings for her. I was too young to understand at first but she was probably my first love.

I yearned for her. The milf next door.
I wanted it to be this way forever and ever.
